highlights.title: Wat Pa Lelai Worawihan
highlights.alt: Suphanburi cultural landmark near Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel
highlights.text: One of Suphanburi's best-known temple landmarks, often included in a first visit to the city for its local heritage and easy access from the central area.

highlights.title: Dragon Descendants Museum
highlights.alt: Suphanburi city attraction near Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel
highlights.text: A distinctive cultural stop in Suphanburi, known for its dramatic dragon form and exhibitions connected to Thai-Chinese heritage.

highlights.title: Banharn-Jamsai Tower
highlights.alt: Suphanburi city view reference near Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel
highlights.text: A useful city orientation point for guests who want a broader view of Suphanburi and a simple landmark to plan around.

highlights.title: Sam Chuk Old Market
highlights.alt: Suphanburi travel highlight near Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel
highlights.text: A heritage market experience for local food, nostalgic shopfronts, and an easy half-day outing from the hotel.

highlights.title: Bueng Chawak
highlights.alt: Family travel highlight near Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel
highlights.text: A family-friendly destination often paired with relaxed day trips, local dining, and a slower Suphanburi itinerary.
